related.title: OpenSearch Data Prepper：死信佇列與安全重送驗收
related.titleEn: OpenSearch Data Prepper: dead-letter queues and controlled replay
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付頁面清單、快照識別、去重前後摘要、缺ID與重ID列表，以及可重跑的查詢參數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver page manifests, snapshot identity, pre/post-dedup summaries, missing and duplicate IDs, and reproducible query parameters.
related.difference: 分類可修復格式錯誤、暫時後端失敗與無法解碼資料，為每個事件保留原始bytes摘要及失敗原因。
related.differenceEn: Classify repairable schema failures, transient backend failures and undecodable data, preserving original byte digests and failure reasons.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 匯出完整性需同時檢查唯一數與預期集合；總行數正確仍可能由重複與遺漏互相抵消。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 預期1000個ID，匯出每頁100列共10頁；跨頁漂移使20個ID重複且20個預期ID缺席。 檔案仍1000列，但唯一ID只有980，預期覆蓋980/1000=98%。
回收率以進入死信的唯一事件為分母；成功重送次數不能取代唯一成功事件數。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100筆死信中，60筆可修格式、25筆暫時錯誤、15筆無法解碼；第一次成功回收其中50、20、0筆。 唯一回收70筆，回收率70%；剩30筆須維持原因與負責人，不能靜默刪除。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Export completeness requires unique counts and expected-set comparison; duplicate and missing rows can cancel in total counts. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Expect 1000 IDs across ten pages of one hundred rows; pagination drift duplicates twenty IDs and omits twenty expected IDs. The file still contains 1000 rows, but only 980 unique expected IDs, producing 98% coverage.

Recovery rate uses unique dead-letter events as denominator; successful retry attempts cannot replace unique recovered records. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Of one hundred dead-letter records, sixty have repairable schema errors, twenty-five transient faults and fifteen undecodable payloads; recovery succeeds for 50,20,0. Seventy unique events recover, giving 70%; thirty retain unresolved reasons and owners rather than disappearing silently.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Alertmanager：抑制規則的租戶鍵與空值陷阱
related.titleEn: Alertmanager: tenant keys and missing-label inhibition traps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付頁面清單、快照識別、去重前後摘要、缺ID與重ID列表，以及可重跑的查詢參數。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver page manifests, snapshot identity, pre/post-dedup summaries, missing and duplicate IDs, and reproducible query parameters.
related.difference: 用合成警示建立source、target、tenant、cluster四欄真值表，先界定允許被抑制的範圍。
related.differenceEn: Build source, target, tenant and cluster truth tables for synthetic alerts, defining allowed inhibition scope beforehand.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 匯出完整性需同時檢查唯一數與預期集合；總行數正確仍可能由重複與遺漏互相抵消。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 預期1000個ID，匯出每頁100列共10頁；跨頁漂移使20個ID重複且20個預期ID缺席。 檔案仍1000列，但唯一ID只有980，預期覆蓋980/1000=98%。
抑制可減少重複通知但不刪除事件；跨租戶誤抑制的代價需單獨計數而非視為降噪成功。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有12筆target，A租戶8、B租戶4；A故障source本應只抑制A的8筆，缺tenant鍵卻抑制全部12筆。 錯誤抑制4筆，占原12筆target的33.333333%；本課不用此比例推論整體風險。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Export completeness requires unique counts and expected-set comparison; duplicate and missing rows can cancel in total counts. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Expect 1000 IDs across ten pages of one hundred rows; pagination drift duplicates twenty IDs and omits twenty expected IDs. The file still contains 1000 rows, but only 980 unique expected IDs, producing 98% coverage.

Inhibition reduces notifications without deleting events; cross-tenant suppression must be counted separately from useful noise reduction. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twelve targets include eight in tenant A and four in B; an A source should inhibit eight, but a missing tenant key suppresses all twelve. Four targets are suppressed incorrectly, or 33.333333% of the original target set, without implying a global risk probability.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
